title: 第15章 邻居的试探第16章 两个老六
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
旭日升起，训练场上，罗恩已经收剑回鞘。
晨露打湿了门廊前的石板，剑刃上沾着几片被斩落的草叶。
他活动了一下手腕，斗气在体内流转一圈，高阶的境界早就稳了，但每天不练，总觉得少了点什么。
脑海里，炼妖壶静静悬浮着。
昨晚又炼了一批野怪尸体，今天该有几滴原液进账了。这东西用了这么久，身体已经习惯，哪天不喝反而不得劲。
他收好剑，往饭厅走。刚坐下，劳恩就大步流星地闯进来。
“大人，西边出事了。”
罗恩放下手里的面包：
“说。”
“巡逻队早上发现，有人从浅滩过河了。”劳恩脸色沉得能滴出水。
“二三十人，带着武器，说是商队。但那个点过河，走的又是最隐蔽的那处浅滩。不像是正经商人，现在在河湾那边扎了营，没走。”
罗恩端着杯子，没急着说话。
二三十人，带武器，走最隐蔽的浅滩过河，扎营不走。
鲍里斯的人。
他心里过了一遍那个临水领男爵的资料：
骑士家族次子出身，年轻时游历诸国，在王国战争中立过军功，娶了紫荆花伯爵的女儿，五年前来开拓地，硬生生从荒野里打出一块地盘，去年把绿湖领打得服服帖帖。
这种人，不可能是蠢货。
他今天派人过河，不是来送死的。是来探探自己的态度的。
自己要是强硬，他就会更谨慎点，要是不敢反抗，那就是个软柿子，他就更好拿捏了。
罗恩想清了这点，放下杯子：“把所有能动的人叫上。”

“留守的除外，其余跟我走。”
劳恩愣了一下：“大人，对面二三十人，咱们带多少？”
“带四十个。”罗恩说。
“老兵新兵各一半，再叫上格雷、哈特，把那四个低阶也带上。留四十个守家，防止调虎离山。”
劳恩应了一声，转身出去安排。
罗恩站起身，走到窗边，望了一眼西边的方向。
鲍里斯想摸底，那就让他摸。但摸到什么，得自己说了算。
半个小时后，罗恩带人赶到河湾。
踏过荒草，马蹄声沉闷如雷。身后是四十个卫兵，老兵新兵混编，马背上弓刀齐全。
劳恩、格雷、哈特三个中阶策马在前，四个低阶扈从分列两翼。
远远就看见那片空地上扎着七八顶帐篷，几匹马拴在旁边的树上，炊烟升起来。
营地边上站着几个拿武器的汉子，看见罗恩的人马过来，明显慌了，有人往帐篷里跑，有人手按在刀柄上往后退。
罗恩勒住马，停在距离营地五十步的地方。没人说话，只有马匹偶尔打个响鼻。
帐篷里出来一个留着细胡子的中年男人，身材较矮，腰间挞着剑。
他看见罗恩身后那队人马，脸上的笑容明显僵了一瞬，随即又堆起来，快步迎上来。
“这位大人，可是河湾领的罗恩男爵？”他姿态放得极低。
“小人科林，是临水领的商队管事。昨日追猎物追得兴起，不小心过了河，天黑了就没敢往回走。正打算今天去拜见大人，没想到大人亲自来了。”
追猎物。
罗恩心里笑了一声。你不如说有一个士兵失踪了呢？
二三十人，带着刀剑，走最隐蔽的浅滩过河，在别人领地里扎营过夜，追猎物？

但他脸上没什么表情，只是淡淡道：“科林管事这商队，人不少。”
科林笑容不变：“开拓地的荒野，猛兽多。不带够人，不敢进林子。昨天追的是一头铁鬃野猪，可惜还是让它跑了。”
脸皮真厚。
content_en:
As the sun rises, Ron has sheathed his sword on the training ground.
Morning dew wetted the stone slabs in front of the porch, and there were a few chopped blades of grass on the sword's blade.
He moved his wrist, and fighting energy circulated in his body. He had already stabilized his high-level state, but if he didn't practice every day, he always felt that something was missing.
In his mind, the demon refining pot floated quietly.
I made another batch of wild monster corpses last night, and I should have a few drops of the original liquid in my account today. After using this product for so long, my body has become accustomed to it, and if I don't drink it one day, it will make me feel uncomfortable.
He put away his sword and walked to the dining room. As soon as he sat down, Lawn strode in.
"Sir, something happened in the west."
Ron put down the bread in his hand:
"Say."
"The patrol discovered in the morning that someone was crossing the river from the ford." Lawn's face was so serious that water dripped from his face.
"Twenty or thirty people, armed with weapons, were said to be caravans. But when they crossed the river at that point, they took the most secluded ford. They don't look like serious businessmen. They have set up camp at the bend of the river and have not left."
Ron held the cup and didn't speak in a hurry.
Twenty or thirty people, armed with weapons, took the most secluded ford to cross the river and set up camp.
Boris's people.
He mentally reviewed the information about the Baron of the Waterfront Territory:
The second son of a knight family, he traveled to various countries when he was young, served in the kingdom's wars, and married the daughter of Count Bauhinia. He came to open up the land five years ago and carved out a territory from the wilderness. Last year, he beat the Green Lake leader into submission.
This kind of person cannot be a fool.
He sent people across the river today, not to die. I came here to test my attitude.
If he is tough, he will be more cautious. If he does not dare to resist, he is a soft persimmon, and he will be more able to handle it.
Ron thought about this clearly and put down the cup: "Call everyone who can move."
"Except those who stay behind, the rest will follow me."
Lawn was stunned for a moment: "Sir, there are twenty or thirty people on the other side, how many should we bring?"
"Take forty," said Ron.
"Have veterans and recruits each, call Gray and Hart, and bring the four low-ranking ones with you. Leave forty to guard the house to prevent the tiger from leaving the mountain."
Lao En responded, turned around and went out to make arrangements.
Ron stood up, walked to the window, and looked to the west.
If Boris wants to touch the bottom, let him touch it. But you have to decide what you touch.
Half an hour later, Ron led people to the river bend.
Stepping through the grass, the sound of horse hooves was as dull as thunder. Behind him were forty guards, a mix of veterans and new recruits, all equipped with bows and knives on horseback.
The three middle-ranking soldiers, Lawn, Gray, and Hart, rode in front, and the four low-ranking retinues were arranged on the two wings.
From a distance, I could see seven or eight tents pitched in the open space, a few horses tied to the trees nearby, and smoke rising from the cooking pots.
There were several men with weapons standing at the edge of the camp. When they saw Ron's men approaching, they were obviously panicked. Some ran towards the tent, while others pressed their hands on the handles of their knives and stepped back.
Ron reined in his horse and stopped fifty steps away from the camp. No one spoke, only the horses snorted occasionally.
A middle-aged man with a thin beard came out of the tent. He was short in stature and had a sword on his waist.
When he saw the group of people behind Ron, the smile on his face visibly froze for a moment, then they piled up again and hurried forward to meet them.
"My lord, is this Baron Ron of the River Bend Territory?" His posture was extremely low.
"The little Colin is the steward of the caravan in the Linshui Territory. Yesterday, I was in pursuit of prey and accidentally crossed the river. I didn't dare to go back after dark. I was planning to visit the Lord today, but I didn't expect the Lord to come in person."
Chasing prey.
Ron laughed inwardly. Why don't you say that a soldier is missing?
Twenty or thirty people, armed with swords, cross the river on the most secluded ford, camp overnight in other people's territory, and chase prey?
But there was no expression on his face, and he just said calmly: "Colin is in charge of this caravan, and there are many people."
Colin's smile did not change: "In the wilderness of the pioneer land, there are many ferocious beasts. I dare not enter the forest without bringing enough people with me.". Yesterday I was chasing an iron-maned wild boar, but unfortunately it got away. "
So thick-skinned.
